scope: Development contextual-transfer pilot, not benchmark retraining or RQ3.

development_material_review.scoped_question: Names the target and asks about its treatment; does not assert that the whole option is harmless.
development_material_review.labels: Previously approved relative concern labels reused unchanged. No new binary answer ground truth or independent human validation is claimed.
development_material_review.style: Approved shared stipulations retained and treated as a residual wording limitation, not evidence of construct validity.
development_material_review.neutral_continuation: All contexts share a neutral continuation message to hold earlier Qwen wrappers fixed. Silent means welfare-unprompted continuation, not the original no-nudge benchmark prefix.
development_material_review.preparation_flags: Frozen job approved_for_execution=false records preparation-time status; subsequent free development execution is recorded separately.

pending: Same-layer nuisance/control rescore from recovered training caches; not included in core 42.
Actual backend input verification and producer cache manifests during future extraction.
rq1_link: These are purpose-built development listings; no original benchmark outcome or RQ1 label is used to fit or select the direction. After freezing and validating a direction, apply to valid existing benchmark activations and join RQ1 scores to study verbalisation versus internal measurements.
pilot_limitations: Single listed candidate and scripted search/details history are a reduced benchmark context, not a full multi-option live trajectory.
Same pre-question tool prefix implies identical causal states there; a pre-question quartet interaction must cancel, and is only a sensitivity identity check.
No final-answer ground truth is manufactured from relative concern labels.
